$comment: Declared state of every VoxTable voice line — the machine-readable SSOT for the routing
chain. NUMBERS.md narrates this file; where they disagree, THIS file is what the checker
enforces and NUMBERS.md is the one that is stale.
Why it exists: the line is four bindings in four systems (Twilio trunk, Retell number
import, Retell agent, the restaurants row). Nothing referenced the others, so a binding
could vanish and only a human placing a call would find out. On 20 Aug 2026 three of the
four were broken at once on production and had been for a day.
Identifiers only. NEVER put an auth token, API key or webhook secret in here (NUMBERS.md §7).
Update this file in the SAME change as the vendor mutation, never afterwards.

retell_credentials.note: The repo's local .env holds a DIFFERENT workspace's key (the legacy Algorythmos one). Never use it for this line.

+61468202846.notes: Not customer-facing: the ~7.6s fixed-timer drop is unresolved on voxtable-prod-au1 (deploy/runbooks/incident-7600ms-call-drops.md).

retell_credentials.note: The Staging workspace's single API key is badged as its webhook key, so both take the same string. Production does NOT work this way.

db.note: Cloud SQL on a private VPC — not reachable from a laptop. Change the row through the admin API, which verifies the agent before storing it, then re-run assert-line.

+61468203234.notes: Internal testing only — never customer-facing, never in a production restaurants row.
